page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, no margin notes. Running head at top centre; page number at top left; catchword-like signature "DODO" at lower right is a gathering mark.

main_text.head: WILIMANNVS CLERICVS.
main_text.p: In vico Vinnona Rhætiæ Curiensis, Andreæ Presbyteri successor. Scripsit CH.32. An. Dom, 863.
main_text.head: LAVDO CLERICVS.
main_text.p: Natione Rhætus, suppresso loci nomine, Scripsit CH.35. De anno nihil certi liquet, nisi quod circiter Dccxx. vixerit.
main_text.head: SILVESTER DIACONVS S. GALLI.
main_text.p: Scripsit CH.36. An. Dom.742. CH.37. An. Dom.744. CH.38. sine anno & Rege.
main_text.head: HIRINGVS MONACHVS ET LECTOR Babinchouensis.
main_text.p: Scripsit CH.39. An. Dom.744. & notabilem CH.58. An. Dom.745.
main_text.head: LANDARIVS PRESBYTER RAVDINLEI- menfis.
main_text.p: In Rhætia Curiensi inferiore, vt ex principio chartæ colligitur. Scripsit CH. 40. An. Dom.752.
main_text.head: LIVTFREDVS PRESBYTER.
main_text.p: S. Gallinean in vico aliquo, non exprimitur. Scripsit CH. 42. Anno Domini 754.
main_text.head: MOATHELMVS CLERICVS.
main_text.p: Scripsit CH.45. Anno Domini 770. Locus Parochialis non exprimitur.
main_text.head: VSALTO DIACONVS S. GALLI.
main_text.p: Natione Thurcgiensis, scripsit CH.46. Anno Dom.773.
main_text.head: EMICHO.
main_text.p: Quis iste fuerit, aut quinam pagus (quæ vox distinctum seu territorium notat) Purihinga, seu (vt in charta 87. scribitur) Burichinzas, æque cum ignarissimis scio: nisi si in Rhætia Curiensi aliquis sit, quod animus auguratur. Scripsit CH.47. An.Dom.805.
main_text.head: ADALHARDVS LECTOR S. GALLI.
main_text.p: Scripsit CH.48. An. Dom. 795. Argunæ (quæ nostrati vulgo Langenargen/) trans lacum Potamicum.
main_text.head: PERNEGARIVS PRESBYTER.
main_text.p: Neq; huius siue monasterium siue Parochia exprimitur. Scripsit CH. 49. An.Dom.802.
main_text.head: ATTO CLERICVS AVGVSTANENSIS.
main_text.p: Scripsit CH. 50. An. Dom.825. Munciacum an est München/quod imperiti vocant Monachium? Diuinet, qui fauente vtitur Apolline, an Monachium in pago Augustouiano situm fuerit.
main_text.head: RATBERTVS CONZL.
main_text.p: Non queo nec possum diuinare, quid sibi velit vocabulū posterius. Ipse Ratbertus Brisgouiensis fuit. Scripsit CH. 81. An.Dom.819. & CH.51. An. Do.828. in quibus chartis constanter scriptum est Hratbertus, sicut in aliis vetustis codicibus Heabanus, Hradulphus, Hratherius, Hrichardus, & id genus similia.
main_text.head: BEBO.
main_text.p: Quia testem se vocat in re, quæ Monasterium non obligat, non videtur Monachus fuisse. Exscripsit tantum CH. 52. quam Notkerus Balbulus composuit An.Dom.851.

page.notes: Printed headings are set in small capitals and italics; treated as level 2 headings. Marginal text: none clearly legible. Words such as "Langenargen" printed in black letter inside the text were transcribed as printed; "Munchen" rendered with black-letter form. Some letters in the running head and the bottom "DODO" are uncertain.
